description: Move an existing remote artifact to the trash when the user explicitly asks to delete it. This removes it from normal access; it is not an upload cancellation or a way to hide a share link. Verify the intended artifact using find/get_site when ambiguous. Requires ownership or equivalent authorized privileges; returns deletion confirmation.

share_token.description: Token from a user-provided share URL; carries only that share permission.

slug.description: Artifact identifier returned by find/publish, or the slug in its /s/ URL. Not a local path.

tenant_id.description: Destination tenant for creation; defaults to the account tenant.

name: artifact_site_delete
title: Delete a site
